episode.showDescription: The official podcast of comedian Joe Rogan.
episode.episodeDescription: Jimmy Donaldson, better known as MrBeast, is a YouTuber, entrepreneur, and philanthropist. He is the founder of Beast Industries and Beast Philanthropy, and the creator and host of the Prime Video competition series “Beast Games.”www.beastgames.comwww.beastphilanthropy.orgwww.youtube.com/@MrBeast Learn more about your ad choices. Visit podcastchoices.com/adchoices

transcript_window.text: Where did you get this idea?
YouTube.
Did your mom know about this?
Shouldn't you be in school?
I'd be like, I don't know.
It was such a like.
How many hours a day do you spend waking up content?
Hey, man, go outside.
Go talk to a woman.
I mean, back then, too, I was so like introverted and self -conscious.
I probably wouldn't have said anything.
I would have been like, uh, yeah.
Uh -huh.
You know, because you have to kind of be a little, it's interesting too, because it's like very accepted to be a content creator.
It's like, cool.
People love it.
It's like, even parents now, like, you know, they're like, do it.
And they realize that while being a content creator, you learn a lot of different skill sets and it teaches self -agency, et cetera.
But back then, I mean, it was like, you're batshit crazy, very frowned upon.
And like, so it's so funny to see how that changes because like, you know, it's the number one most coveted job in America right now.
Like if you were to go survey like 100 random teenagers, a lot of them, a good chunk of them would say they want to be a content creator.
Maybe not specifically a YouTuber, but between TikTok, Instagram, influencer, like, you know.
It's probably the number one job that kids want.
It is, factually, yes.
And so, but, you know, when I was coming up, heck no.
It's like, what are you, a weirdo?
